name: Hochland Bandits

specialRules.name: Hired Swords
specialRules.text: May hire any Hired Swords allowed to a Human Mercenary warband.

specialRules.name: Powder's Expensive
specialRules.text: Bandits are too poor for black powder weapons; only Bandit heroes can buy them (at higher costs) and henchmen cannot purchase them at all.

specialRules.name: Foragers
specialRules.text: When determining Income always use the next lower warband size category (a warband of 1-3 members still uses the first column).

specialRules.name: Know Who To Sell To
specialRules.text: When selling equipment, the warband gets half of any random element of the equipment cost in addition to the normal half of the item's basic cost.

items.name: Rapier
items.note: Rare 5; close combat, Strength as user, Parry, Barrage, +1 enemy armour save. Barrage: if you hit but fail to wound, you may attack again at -1 to hit (to a maximum of needing 6 to hit), repeating as long as you hit.

items.name: Main Gauche
items.note: Rare 7; close combat, Strength as user, Parry, +1 enemy armour save.

fighters.name: Bandit Prince

specialRules.name: Leader
specialRules.text: Any warrior within 6" may use his Leadership characteristic when taking any Leadership tests.

fighters.notes: Exactly one per warband. PDF says 'Bandit Heroes Equipment list' which is not printed; Bandit equipment list assumed.

specialRules.name: Concealment
specialRules.text: An enemy charging a Footpad it cannot see (but who was not declared Hidden) subtracts 1 from Initiative before the Initiative test; a roll of 12 always fails when charging a Footpad the warrior cannot see. Models halve their Initiative when checking range to detect a Hiding Footpad.

specialRules.name: Swordmaster
specialRules.text: A Duelist parries an enemy blow on a roll equal to or over the roll to hit, not just over it (must be armed with a weapon or armour that allows him to Parry).

specialRules.name: Weapon Knowledge
specialRules.text: May use any close combat or missile weapon the warband members can get hold of; the equipment list only shows what he may start with.

specialRules.name: Convincing Manner
specialRules.text: An enemy charging a member of the huckster's warband within 12" of the huckster must first pass a Leadership test; on a failure it stays stationary (treat as a failed charge, as for Fear). Models subject to Stupidity and animals are immune.

specialRules.name: Slick Operator
specialRules.text: Between games, the player may have the huckster run a con: roll a D12; on 3-12 the warband gains 2D6 gold, on 1-2 the con backfires, he misses the next game and no gold is received. May not be combined with the Banditry skill.

specialRules.name: Looting the Dead
specialRules.text: After a battle, for each Looter roll a D12 for any warrior of any warband taken Out of Action who is to be removed from his roster; on 7+ the Looter takes all of his equipment for the Bandit player. A warrior may only be looted once.

specialRules.name: Hardened
specialRules.text: Immune to Fear and never has to take All Alone tests.

specialRules.name: Trailblazers
specialRules.text: The warband may re-roll one D6 for each Poacher in the Exploration phase (Poachers re-roll one exploration die each).

conversionNotes: Bandit Prince's list is called 'Bandit Heroes Equipment list' in the PDF but only a Bandit equipment list is printed; used it for him. Powder's Expensive says heroes may buy black powder weapons, but pistols only appear on the Duelist list, so only the Duelist can buy them as written.

Special skills in PDF: Banditry (D6 2-6 success / 1 failure, adds D6+1 gold), Hide in Shadows, Jump Back, Sniper, Throw Voice (D6 4+ -> 7+). Banditry D6 2-6 would be 3-12 by analogy; not applied since skills are not copied into fighters.
Conversions applied: Looting the Dead 4+ -> 7+; Footpad Concealment roll of 6 -> 12; Slick Operator D6 2-6 / 1 -> D12 3-12 / 1-2 (judgement call, the schema table has no 2-6 entry).
Trailblazers: original says re-roll one D6 for each Poacher in the Exploration phase; left as D6 exploration dice (not a to-hit/save roll).
Poacher/Blackheart/Gutterscum 'groups of 1-5' henchman rule from the PDF header is assumed; limits 0-2 Blackhearts, 0-2 Poachers, 0-4 Looters are warband-wide.
